top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.
Develop and maintain an Emergency Preparedness Program (EP).
Create arrangements with other facilities to receive patients.
Implement emergency and standby power systems.
Install smoke barrier doors that can resist smoke for at least 20 minutes.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
